tha-ap487:1.1: samattaṃ. [482. Candanamāliya.] Pañcakāmaguṇe hitvā piyarūpe manorame / asītikoṭiyo hitvā pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ. // //
tha-ap487:2.1: Pabbajitvāna kāyena pāpakammaṃ vivajjayiṃ / vacīduccaritaṃ hitvā nadīkūle vasām' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap487:3.1: Ekakammaṃ vihāraṃ taṃ Buddhaseṭṭho upāgamī / nāhaṃ jānāmi Buddho ti akāsiṃ paṭisantharaṃ. // //
tha-ap487:4.1: Karitvā paṭisanthāraṃ nāmagottaṃ apucch' ahaṃ: / devatā nu 'si gandhabbo uda Sakko Purindado? // //
tha-ap487:5.1: Ko vā tvaṃ kassa vā putto mahābrahmā idhāgato / virocesi disā sabbā udayaṃ suriyo yathā. // //
tha-ap487:6.1: Sahassarāṇi cakkāni pāde dissanti mārisa / ko va tvaṃ kassa vā putto kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayaṃ? / nāmagottaṃ pavedehi saṃsayaṃ apanehi me! // //
tha-ap487:7.1: ‘N' amhi devo na gandhabbo n' amhi Sakko Purindado / brahmā bhāvo ca me n' atthi etesaṃ uttamo ahaṃ // //
tha-ap487:8.1: Atīto visayaṃ tesaṃ dālayiṃ kāmabandhanaṃ / sabbe kilese jhāpetvā patto sambodhim uttamaṃ.' // //
tha-ap487:9.1: Tassa vācaṃ suṇitvāhaṃ imaṃ vacanam abraviṃ: / yadi Buddho ' si sabbaññū nisīda tvaṃ mahāmune /
tha-ap487:10.1: tam ahaṃ pūjayissāmi dukkass' antakaro tuvaṃ. // // Pattharitvā 'jinaṃ cammaṃ adāsiṃ satthuno ahaṃ /
tha-ap487:11.1: nisīdi tattha bhagavā sīho va girigabbhare. // // Khippaṃ pabbatam āruyha ambassa phalam aggahiṃ /
tha-ap487:12.1: sālakalyāṇikaṃ pupphaṃ candanañ ca mahārahaṃ. // // Khippaṃ paggayha taṃ sabbaṃ upesiṃ lokanāyakaṃ /
tha-ap487:13.1: phalaṃ Buddhassa datvāna sālapupphaṃ apūjayiṃ. // // Candanaṃ anulimpitvā avandi satthuno ahaṃ /
tha-ap487:14.1: pasannacitto sumano vipulāya ca pītiyā. // // Ajinamhi nisīditvā Sumedho lokanāyako /
tha-ap487:15.1: mama kammaṃ pakittesi hāsayanto mamaṃ tadā: // // ‘Iminā phaladānena gandhamālehi cūbhayaṃ /
tha-ap487:16.1: pañcavīsakappasate devaloke ramissati / anūnamanasaṅkappo Vasavatti bhavissati. // //
tha-ap487:17.1: Chabbīsatikappasate manussattaṃ gamissati / bhavissati cakkavattī cāturanto mahiddhiko. // //
tha-ap487:18.1: Vebhāraṃ nāma nagaraṃ *Vissakammena māpitaṃ* / hessati sabbasovaṇṇaṃ nānāratanabhūsitaṃ. // //
tha-ap487:19.1: Eten' eva upāyena saṃsarissati yoniso / sabbattha sukhito hutvā devatte atha mānuse /
tha-ap487:20.1: pacchime bhave sampatte brahmabandhu bhavissati. // // Agārā abhinikkhamma anāgārī bhavissati / aviññattipaccayo hutvā nibbāyissat' anāsavo.' // //
tha-ap487:21.1: Idaṃ vatvāna sambuddho Sumedho lokanāyako / mama nijjhāyamānassa pakkāmi anilañjase. // //
tha-ap487:23.1: Tusitāto cavitvāna nibbattiṃ mātukucchiyaṃ / bhoge me ūnatā n' atthi yamhi gabbhe vasām' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap487:24.1: Mātukucchigate mayhaṃ annapānañ ca bhojanaṃ / mātuyā mama chandena nibbattati yadicchakaṃ. // //
tha-ap487:25.1: Jātiyā pañcavassena pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ / oropitamhi kesamhi arahattaṃ apāpuṇiṃ. // //
tha-ap487:26.1: Pubbakammaṃ gavesanto orena nāddasaṃ ahaṃ / tiṃsakappasahassamhi mama kammaṃ anussariṃ. // //
tha-ap487:27.1: Namo te purisājañña! Namo te purisuttama! / tava sāsanam āgamma patto 'mhi acalam padaṃ. // //
tha-ap487:28.1: Tiṃsakappasahassamhi yam Buddham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap487:32.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Candanamāliyo thero i. g. a-ti.
